title: Evaluate NASA POWER Daily Regional acquisition

acceptance.text: A separate checksum-aware Regional API client, bounded four-parameter smoke test and nationwide proposal preserve original point coordinates, returned output coordinates and native-grid claims as distinct evidence without starting the full collection or changing G0.
acceptance.evidence: Verified the official Daily Regional contract and live restrictions; implemented a separate JSON regional downloader with exact-byte storage, structural validation, retries and checksum-aware resume. The bounded 2 degree by 2 degree smoke completed four successful parameter requests, each with 12 returned coordinates and three LST dates, expected units and zero fill values. Exact coordinate/date alignment was observed without claiming native-cell identity; five regional tests and all 75 repository tests passed.
